facts.fact: Chad's payment-institution licences are granted by the Central African Banking Commission (Cobac) under the CEMAC regulation of 21 December 2018; Airtel Money (2023), Konoom (2025) and Moov Money Tchad (2026) hold one.
To keep its licence Moov Money Tchad must ring-fence client funds, meet solvency norms and run regular cybersecurity audits, per the article on the CEMAC payment-institution rules.
Moov Money Tchad's payment-institution licence permits cross-border fund transfers and the article says it can offer them across the CEMAC zone; no corridor is named as in service.

TCD.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: Moov Money Tchad, Airtel Money and Konoom are licensed payment institutions in Chad, and BEAC counted FCFA 526.7 billion of mobile transactions there at end-2024.

TCD.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
